name: Epic Games
summary: Epic Games is a notable private company in gaming.
overview: Epic Games is included in The Private Ledger’s company directory for ongoing research.

facts.label: Latest disclosed financing
facts.note: Publicly reported financing context; verify before relying on it.

bull_case: Fortnite and Unreal Engine combine a major consumer platform with strategic developer tools.
bear_case: Hit-driven entertainment and high content costs can make growth uneven.

intelligence.description: Epic Games operates Fortnite, Unreal Engine and the Epic Games Store, combining a consumer entertainment platform with widely used development tools.
company: Epic's ecosystem spans Fortnite, Unreal Engine, digital distribution and creator tools. This gives it both hit-driven entertainment exposure and infrastructure-like software economics.
Disney invested $1.5B in 2024 to develop a connected games and entertainment universe with Epic, adding a strategic partner to a long-standing private shareholder base.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Epic is one of the largest private consumer-internet platforms. It matters beyond gaming because its engine, marketplace and creator ecosystem influence how interactive media and virtual worlds are built and monetized.

changed.text: Disney invested $1.5B to create a persistent games and entertainment universe connected to Fortnite.
Updated Epic Games Store economics, including a 0% revenue share on the first $1M in annual per-app revenue processed by Epic.

takeaways: Fortnite is both a game and a distribution platform for experiences and creators.
Unreal Engine creates strategic reach beyond Epic's own content.
Engagement volatility and high content investment make earnings less predictable than software peers.
